markdown: **Activate—Watery Form** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentration](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You dissolve into liquid, appearing only as a stretch of flowing water. While in this form, you gain a [swim Speed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2351) of 45 feet, you automatically succeed at [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381), and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks in water. However, you can’t speak, use any of your other items or abilities, or enter a body of salt water while in this form. You can remain in this form for up to 1 hour, though you can return to your normal form using a single action that has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait.

However, you can’t speak, use any of your other items or abilities, or enter a body of salt water while in this form. You can remain in this form for up to 1 hour, though you can return to your normal form using a single action that has the concentrate trait.
